name: Rock Face 01
author: Dario Barresi / Poly Haven
method: V6 source-derived periodic relief geometry unchanged. Scene metadata selects continuous global sampling-coordinate warp at runtime. No independent panel offsets or added geometric noise. Amplitude remains inside original source bounds.
accepted: V7 accepted 2026-09-06 on hardware Chromium and promoted to game/public/assets/models/cave/rock-face-01.glb. See runs/corealm-rebuild/SLICE-09-CAVE-APPEARANCE.md.

runtime.note: The staged GLB carries only the periodic front envelope. The accepted look also depends on the runtime sampling warp in game/src/render/caveSourceDomain.ts and the roof relief budget in game/src/render/dungeon.ts.

derivedFrom.version: v6 (deleted after acceptance; geometry is byte-identical apart from the scene extras that select the runtime warp)
derivedFrom.method: Continuous frontmost source-triangle envelope. Periodic cubic blending of adjacent source fields over a50cm band; unblended interior samples are exact. Only geometry derives from scan; runtime uses continuous world stone, never source atlas interpolation.
